277:     this.persist();
278:     return { journalRevision: this.revision };
279:   }
280: 
281:   unregister(value: unknown): { journalRevision: number; removed: boolean } {
282:     if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value))
283:       throw new Error("Invalid reaper unregister request");
284:     const request = value as { hostInstanceId?: unknown; processId?: unknown; runId?: unknown; nonce?: unknown };
285:     if (
286:       typeof request.hostInstanceId !== "string" ||
287:       typeof request.processId !== "string" ||
288:       typeof request.runId !== "string" ||
289:       typeof request.nonce !== "string"
290:     ) {
291:       throw new Error("Invalid reaper unregister request");
292:     }
293:     const key = `${request.processId}\0${request.runId}`;
294:     const existing = this.records.get(key);
295:     if (!existing) return { journalRevision: this.revision, removed: false };
296:     if (existing.hostInstanceId !== request.hostInstanceId || existing.nonce !== request.nonce) {
297:       throw new Error("Managed process reaper unregister identity mismatch");
298:     }
299:     this.records.delete(key);
300:     this.persist();
301:     return { journalRevision: this.revision, removed: true };
302:   }
303: 
304:   async reapAll(hostInstanceId?: string): Promise<ManagedProcessReaperStatus> {
305:     if (!this.ready) return this.status();
306:     const records = [...this.records.values()].filter(
307:       (record) => !hostInstanceId || record.hostInstanceId === hostInstanceId,
308:     );
309:     const outcomes = await Promise.all(records.map(async (record) => ({ record, outcome: await this.reap(record) })));

311:     for (const { record, outcome } of outcomes) {
312:       if (outcome === "removed") {

314:       } else if (outcome === "identity-uncertain") {
315:         failure = "IDENTITY_UNCERTAIN";
316:       } else if (!failure) {

318:       }
319:     }
320:     if (failure) {
321:       this.ready = false;
322:       this.errorCode = failure;
323:     }
324:     try {
325:       this.persist();
326:     } catch {
327:       this.ready = false;
328:       this.errorCode = "JOURNAL_INVALID";
329:     }
330:     return this.status();
331:   }

333:   private async reap(record: ManagedProcessReaperRecord): Promise<"removed" | "identity-uncertain" | "failed"> {
334:     if (record.platform === "win32") {
335:       if (this.platform !== "win32") return "identity-uncertain";
336:       try {
337:         const outcome = this.reapWindows

344:         if (outcome === "removed") {
345:           this.log(`managed process reaped process=${this.safeId(record.processId)}`);
346:           return "removed";
347:         }
348:         return outcome;
349:       } catch {
350:         return "failed";
351:       }
352:     }
353:     if (this.platform === "win32") return "identity-uncertain";
354:     if (!this.groupExists(record.pgid)) return "removed";
355:     const fingerprint = await this.fingerprint(record.pid);
356:     if (!fingerprint || fingerprint !== record.startFingerprint) {
357:       this.log(`managed process reap refused identity mismatch process=${this.safeId(record.processId)}`);
358:       return "identity-uncertain";
359:     }
360:     const stopped = await this.terminateGroup(record.pgid, { interruptMs: 500, terminateMs: 1_000, forceMs: 1_000 });
361:     if (!stopped) {
362:       this.log(`managed process reap failed process=${this.safeId(record.processId)}`);
363:       return "failed";
364:     }
365:     this.log(`managed process reaped process=${this.safeId(record.processId)}`);
366:     return "removed";
367:   }
368: 
369:   private persist(): void {
370:     this.revision += 1;
371:     writeReaperJournal(this.journalPath, this.revision, [...this.records.values()]);
372:   }
373: 
374:   private key(record: Pick<ManagedProcessReaperRecord, "processId" | "runId">): string {
375:     return `${record.processId}\0${record.runId}`;
376:   }
377: 
378:   private safeId(value: string): string {
379:     return value.replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/gi, "").slice(-12);
380:   }
381: }

119: export class ManagedProcessError extends Error {
120:   readonly code: ManagedProcessErrorCode;
121:   readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>;

123:   constructor(code: ManagedProcessErrorCode, message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown>) {
124:     super(message);

126:     this.code = code;
127:     this.details = details;

131: function deferred(): Deferred {
132:   let resolve!: () => void;
133:   let reject!: (error: Error) => void;
134:   const promise = new Promise<void>((ok, fail) => {
135:     resolve = ok;
136:     reject = fail;
137:   });
138:   return { promise, resolve, reject };
139: }

141: function timeout<T>(
142:   promise: Promise<T>,
143:   timeoutMs: number,
144:   message: string,
145:   code: ManagedProcessErrorCode = "PROCESS_STOP_TIMEOUT",
146: ): Promise<T> {
147:   return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
148:     const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new ManagedProcessError(code, message)), timeoutMs);
149:     timer.unref();
150:     promise.then(
151:       (value) => {
152:         clearTimeout(timer);
153:         resolve(value);
154:       },
155:       (error) => {
156:         clearTimeout(timer);
157:         reject(error);
158:       },
159:     );
160:   });
161: }

171: function toolchainError(error: unknown): ManagedProcessError {
172:   if (error instanceof ToolchainError) {
173:     const code =
174:       error.code === "TOOLCHAIN_PROJECT_UNTRUSTED" ? "PROCESS_PROJECT_UNTRUSTED" : "PROCESS_SHELL_UNAVAILABLE";
175:     return new ManagedProcessError(code, error.message);
176:   }
177:   if (error instanceof ManagedProcessPolicyError) return new ManagedProcessError(error.code, error.message);
178:   if (error instanceof ManagedProcessError) return error;
179:   return new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE", "Could not start the managed process safely");

183:   return value.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, " ").slice(0, 500);

191:   private readonly parentCall: typeof callMain;

193:   private readonly posixBackendFactory: () => ManagedProcessBackend;
194:   private readonly windowsBackendFactory: (descriptor: WindowsManagedProcessHelperDescriptor) => ManagedProcessBackend;
195:   private readonly records = new Map<string, ManagedRecord>();

202:   constructor(server: Pick<RpcServer, "emit">, options: ManagedProcessServiceOptions = {}) {
203:     this.server = server;
204:     this.platform = options.platform ?? process.platform;
205:     this.arch = options.arch ?? process.arch;
206:     this.runtime = options.runtime ?? toolchainRuntime;
207:     this.parentCall = options.parentCall ?? callMain;
208:     this.now = options.now ?? Date.now;
209:     this.posixBackendFactory =
210:       options.posixBackendFactory ??
211:       (() => {
212:         if (this.platform !== "darwin" && this.platform !== "linux") {
213:           throw new Error("POSIX managed process backend is unavailable on this platform");
214:         }
215:         return new PosixManagedProcessBackend({
216:           platform: this.platform,
217:           workerEntryPath: options.workerEntryPath ?? safeWorkerEntryPath(),
218:           workerExecArgv: options.workerExecArgv,
219:           hostInstanceId: HOST_INSTANCE_ID,
220:           spawnProcess: options.spawnProcess ?? spawn,
221:           fingerprint: options.fingerprint ?? getProcessStartFingerprint,
222:           terminateProcessGroup: options.terminateProcessGroup ?? terminatePosixProcessGroup,
223:           now: this.now,
224:         });
225:       });
226:     this.windowsBackendFactory =
227:       options.windowsBackendFactory ?? ((descriptor) => new WindowsJobProcessBackend(descriptor));

234:   list(includeExited = false, ownerSessionId?: string): { revision: number; processes: ManagedProcessPublicInfo[] } {
235:     this.pruneExited();
236:     const processes = [...this.records.values()]
237:       .filter(
238:         (record) =>
239:           (!ownerSessionId || record.ownerSessionId === ownerSessionId) &&
240:           (includeExited || !terminalState(record.state)),
241:       )
242:       .sort((left, right) => right.createdAt - left.createdAt)
243:       .map((record) => this.publicInfo(record));
244:     return { revision: this.revision, processes };

251:   async startForAgent(
252:     ownerSessionId: string,
253:     ownerCwd: string,
254:     trusted: boolean,
255:     params: ManagedProcessStartParams,
256:     signal?: AbortSignal,
257:   ): Promise<ManagedProcessStartResult> {
258:     this.assertStartNotCancelled(signal);
259:     if (this.shuttingDown)
260:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_FEATURE_DISABLED", "Managed processes are shutting down");
261:     await this.assertStartEnabled();
262:     if (!trusted)
263:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
264:         "PROCESS_PROJECT_UNTRUSTED",
265:         "Project trust is required to start a managed process",
266:       );
267:     this.assertStartBudget(ownerSessionId);
268: 
269:     let command: string;
270:     let cwd: string;
271:     try {
272:       command = validateManagedProcessCommand(params.command);
273:     } catch (error) {
274:       if (error instanceof ManagedProcessPolicyError && error.code === "PROCESS_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED") {
275:         const confirmation = await this.parentCall<{ confirmed?: boolean }>(
276:           "managedProcesses.confirmLanBind",
277:           { ownerSessionId, commandHash: managedProcessCommandHash(params.command) },
278:           65_000,
279:         );
280:         if (!confirmation.confirmed) throw toolchainError(error);
281:         command = validateManagedProcessCommand(params.command, true);
282:       } else {
283:         throw toolchainError(error);
284:       }
285:     }
286:     try {
287:       cwd = await resolveManagedProcessCwd(ownerCwd, params.cwd);
288:     } catch (error) {
289:       throw toolchainError(error);
290:     }
291:     this.assertStartNotCancelled(signal);
292: 
293:     const now = this.now();
294:     const processId = `proc-${randomUUID()}`;
295:     const runId = randomUUID();
296:     const record = this.createRecord({
297:       processId,
298:       runId,
299:       generation: 1,
300:       label: normalizeManagedProcessLabel(params.label, command),
301:       kind: params.kind ?? "server",
302:       ownerSessionId,
303:       ownerCwd,
304:       cwd,
305:       command,
306:       activateUi: params.activateUi === true,
307:       createdAt: now,
308:       readinessSpec: params.waitFor ?? { type: "none" },
309:     });
310:     this.records.set(processId, record);
311:     this.emitChanged(record, "created");
312: 
313:     const onAbort = () => {
314:       if (!record.backend || terminalState(record.state)) return;
315:       void this.stop(record.processId, record.runId, "graceful", "agent", record.ownerSessionId).catch(() => undefined);
316:     };
317:     signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
318: 
319:     try {
320:       await this.startRun(record, trusted, signal);
321:       await this.observeInitialWindow(record);
322:       this.assertStartNotCancelled(signal);
323:       return this.startResult(record);
324:     } catch (error) {
325:       await this.cleanupFailedRun(record);
326:       if (!terminalState(record.state)) {
327:         record.state = "failed";
328:         record.exit = { code: null, reason: "error", finishedAt: this.now() };
329:         record.stoppedAt = this.now();
330:         this.append(record, "system", boundedSystemMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)));
331:         this.emitChanged(record, "exit");
332:       }
333:       throw toolchainError(error);
334:     } finally {
335:       signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
336:     }
337:   }
338: 
339:   read(params: ManagedProcessReadParams, ownerSessionId?: string, renderer = false): ManagedProcessLogWindow {
340:     const record = this.requireRecord(params.processId, ownerSessionId);
341:     this.assertRun(record, params.runId, params.cursor);
342:     const maxBytes = normalizeManagedReadBytes(params.maxBytes, renderer);
343:     const result = record.output.read(params.cursor, maxBytes, params.streams);
344:     const records = result.gap
345:       ? [
346:           {
347:             seq: Math.max(0, (parseManagedProcessCursor(result.earliestCursor, record.runId) ?? 0) - 1),
348:             timestamp: this.now(),
349:             stream: "system" as const,
350:             text: `[system] ${result.gap.droppedBytes} bytes / ${result.gap.droppedRecords} records were dropped before this cursor.`,
351:             runId: record.runId,
352:           },
353:           ...result.records,
354:         ]
355:       : result.records;
356:     return {
357:       processId: record.processId,
358:       runId: record.runId,
359:       fromCursor: result.fromCursor,
360:       nextCursor: result.nextCursor,
361:       earliestCursor: result.earliestCursor,
362:       records,
363:       truncated: result.truncated,
364:       ...(result.gap ? { gap: result.gap } : {}),
365:       state: record.state,
366:       readiness: record.readiness,
367:       endpoints: record.endpoints.map((endpoint) => ({ ...endpoint })),
368:       ...(record.exit ? { exit: { ...record.exit } } : {}),
369:     };
370:   }
371: 
372:   async wait(
373:     params: ManagedProcessWaitParams,
374:     ownerSessionId?: string,
375:     renderer = false,
376:     signal?: AbortSignal,
377:   ): Promise<ManagedProcessLogWindow> {
378:     const record = this.requireRecord(params.processId, ownerSessionId);
379:     this.assertRun(record, params.runId, params.cursor);
380:     const contains = params.contains;
381:     if (contains !== undefined && (typeof contains !== "string" || [...contains].length > 256)) {
382:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_LIMIT_REACHED", "wait contains exceeds the 256 character limit");
383:     }
384:     const before = this.read(params, ownerSessionId, renderer);
385:     const initialMatch = contains ? before.records.find((item) => item.text.includes(contains))?.text : undefined;
386:     if (before.records.length > 0 || terminalState(record.state) || initialMatch) {
387:       return { ...before, ...(initialMatch ? { matched: initialMatch } : {}) };
388:     }
389:     if (!renderer && record.agentWaitActive) {
390:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_LIMIT_REACHED", "Only one Agent wait is allowed per managed process");
391:     }
392:     if (!renderer) record.agentWaitActive = true;
393: 
394:     const timeoutMs = normalizeManagedWaitMs(params.timeoutMs);
395:     let timedOut = false;
396:     try {
397:       await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
398:         const waiter: Waiter = { resolve };
399:         record.waiters.add(waiter);
400:         const onAbort = () => {
401:           clearTimeout(timer);
402:           record.waiters.delete(waiter);
403:           reject(signal?.reason instanceof Error ? signal.reason : new Error("Managed process wait cancelled"));
404:         };
405:         const timer = setTimeout(() => {
406:           timedOut = true;
407:           record.waiters.delete(waiter);
408:           signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
409:           resolve();
410:         }, timeoutMs);
411:         timer.unref();
412:         waiter.resolve = () => {
413:           clearTimeout(timer);
414:           record.waiters.delete(waiter);
415:           signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
416:           resolve();
417:         };
418:         if (signal?.aborted) onAbort();
419:         else signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
420:       });
421:     } finally {
422:       if (!renderer) record.agentWaitActive = false;
423:     }
424:     const result = this.read(params, ownerSessionId, renderer);
425:     const matched = contains ? result.records.find((item) => item.text.includes(contains))?.text : undefined;
426:     return { ...result, ...(timedOut ? { timedOut: true } : {}), ...(matched ? { matched } : {}) };
427:   }
428: 
429:   write(params: ManagedProcessWriteParams, ownerSessionId?: string): { ok: true; runId: string } {
430:     const record = this.requireRecord(params.processId, ownerSessionId);
431:     this.assertRun(record, params.runId);
432:     if (record.state !== "running" && record.state !== "ready") {
433:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING", "Managed process is not running");
434:     }
435:     if (!record.stdinOpen || !record.backend) {
436:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_STDIN_CLOSED", "Managed process stdin is closed");
437:     }
438:     if (typeof params.text !== "string" || Buffer.byteLength(params.text, "utf8") > MANAGED_PROCESS_LIMITS.stdinBytes) {
439:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_LIMIT_REACHED", "stdin write exceeds the 64 KiB limit");
440:     }
441:     this.assertStdinRate(record, Buffer.byteLength(params.text, "utf8"));
442:     record.backend.write({
443:       text: params.text,
444:       appendNewline: params.appendNewline !== false,
445:       close: params.close === true,
446:     });
447:     if (params.close) record.stdinOpen = false;
448:     this.emitChanged(record, "state");
449:     return { ok: true, runId: record.runId };
450:   }

452:   async stop(
453:     processId: string,
454:     runId: string,
455:     mode: ManagedProcessStopMode = "graceful",
456:     source: ManagedProcessStopSource = "user",
457:     ownerSessionId?: string,
458:   ): Promise<ManagedProcessPublicInfo> {
459:     const record = this.requireRecord(processId, ownerSessionId);
460:     this.assertRun(record, runId);
461:     if (terminalState(record.state)) return this.publicInfo(record);
462:     if (source === "user") record.userStopBarrier = true;
463:     record.stopSource = source;
464:     record.state = "stopping";
465:     this.append(record, "system", `Stop requested by ${source} (${mode})`);
466:     this.emitChanged(record, "state");
467:     if (!record.backend) {
468:       record.state = "killed";
469:       record.stoppedAt = this.now();
470:       record.stdinOpen = false;
471:       record.exit = { code: null, reason: "stopped", stoppedBy: source, finishedAt: this.now() };
472:       record.finish?.resolve();
473:       this.emitChanged(record, "exit");
474:       return this.publicInfo(record);
475:     }
476:     try {
477:       await record.backend.stop(mode, source);
478:     } catch {
479:       // The timeout cleanup below disposes the backend containment.
480:     }
481:     try {
482:       await timeout(
483:         record.finish?.promise ?? Promise.resolve(),
484:         STOP_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS,
485:         "Managed process did not stop in time",
486:       );
487:     } catch (error) {
488:       await record.backend.dispose();
489:       if (!terminalState(record.state)) {
490:         this.containmentFailed = true;
491:         record.state = "lost";
492:         record.stoppedAt = this.now();
493:         record.stdinOpen = false;
494:         record.exit = { code: null, reason: "host-failure", stoppedBy: source, finishedAt: this.now() };
495:         this.append(record, "system", "Managed process cleanup could not be verified; new starts are disabled");
496:         this.emitChanged(record, "exit");
497:         record.finish?.resolve();
498:       }
499:       if (!terminalState(record.state)) {
500:         record.state = "killed";
501:         record.stoppedAt = this.now();
502:         record.exit = { code: null, reason: "stopped", stoppedBy: source, finishedAt: this.now() };
503:         this.emitChanged(record, "exit");
504:         record.finish?.resolve();
505:       }
506:       if (error instanceof ManagedProcessError && mode !== "force") {
507:         this.append(record, "system", "Graceful stop timed out; process tree was force terminated");
508:       }
509:     }
510:     return this.publicInfo(record);
511:   }

513:   async restart(
514:     processId: string,
515:     runId: string,
516:     source: "agent" | "user",
517:     ownerSessionId?: string,
518:     trusted = true,
519:   ): Promise<ManagedProcessPublicInfo> {
520:     const record = this.requireRecord(processId, ownerSessionId);
521:     this.assertRun(record, runId);
522:     if (source === "agent" && record.userStopBarrier) {
523:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
524:         "PROCESS_USER_STOPPED",
525:         "The user stopped this process; only a user restart can clear the barrier",
526:       );
527:     }
528:     if (!terminalState(record.state)) await this.stop(processId, runId, "graceful", source, ownerSessionId);
529:     this.assertRun(record, runId);
530:     if (source === "agent" && record.userStopBarrier) {
531:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
532:         "PROCESS_USER_STOPPED",
533:         "The user stopped this process; only a user restart can clear the barrier",
534:       );
535:     }
536:     if (source === "user") record.userStopBarrier = false;
537:     await this.assertStartEnabled();
538:     this.assertRun(record, runId);
539:     if (source === "agent" && record.userStopBarrier) {
540:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
541:         "PROCESS_USER_STOPPED",
542:         "The user stopped this process; only a user restart can clear the barrier",
543:       );
544:     }
545:     if (!trusted)
546:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
547:         "PROCESS_PROJECT_UNTRUSTED",
548:         "Project trust is required to restart a managed process",
549:       );
550: 
551:     record.generation += 1;
552:     record.restartCount += 1;
553:     record.runId = randomUUID();
554:     record.state = "restarting";
555:     record.readiness = record.readinessSpec.type === "none" ? "not-requested" : "pending";
556:     record.readinessMatched = undefined;
557:     record.startedAt = undefined;
558:     record.stoppedAt = undefined;
559:     record.exit = undefined;
560:     record.stdinOpen = true;
561:     record.endpoints = [];
562:     record.networkWarnings = managedProcessNetworkWarnings(record.command);
563:     record.output = new ManagedProcessOutputBuffer(record.runId);
564:     record.decoder = this.createDecoder(record);
565:     record.removeBackendListener?.();
566:     record.backend = undefined;
567:     record.removeBackendListener = undefined;
568:     record.finish = undefined;
569:     record.reaper = undefined;
570:     record.reaperRegistered = false;
571:     record.stopSource = undefined;
572:     record.stdinWindow = [];
573:     this.emitChanged(record, "state");
574:     try {
575:       await this.startRun(record, trusted);
576:       return this.publicInfo(record);
577:     } catch (error) {
578:       await this.cleanupFailedRun(record);
579:       if (!terminalState(record.state)) {
580:         record.state = "failed";
581:         record.exit = { code: null, reason: "error", finishedAt: this.now() };
582:         record.stoppedAt = this.now();
583:         this.append(record, "system", boundedSystemMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)));
584:         this.emitChanged(record, "exit");
585:       }
586:       throw toolchainError(error);
587:     }
588:   }

590:   dismiss(processId: string): { ok: true } {
591:     const record = this.requireRecord(processId);
592:     if (!terminalState(record.state))
593:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING", "Stop the process before dismissing it");
594:     if (record.outputNotifyTimer) clearTimeout(record.outputNotifyTimer);
595:     this.records.delete(processId);
596:     this.notifyMainCount();
597:     this.revision += 1;
598:     const event: ManagedProcessChangedEvent = {
599:       revision: this.revision,
600:       processId,
601:       runId: record.runId,
602:       reason: "dismissed",
603:     };
604:     this.server.emit("processes.changed", processId, event);
605:     return { ok: true };
606:   }

608:   async exportLogs(
609:     processId: string,
610:     runId: string,
611:     streams?: ManagedProcessLogStream[],
612:   ): Promise<{ saved: boolean; fileName?: string }> {
613:     const record = this.requireRecord(processId);
614:     this.assertRun(record, runId);
615:     const streamSet = streams?.length ? new Set(streams) : null;
616:     const content = record.output
617:       .allRecords()
618:       .filter((item) => !streamSet || streamSet.has(item.stream))
619:       .map((item) => `[${new Date(item.timestamp).toISOString()}] [${item.stream}] ${item.text}`)
620:       .join("\n");
621:     const suggestedName = `${record.label.replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/gi, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "process"}.log`;
622:     try {
623:       const target = await this.parentCall<{ path?: string; fileName?: string }>(
624:         "managedProcesses.selectExportTarget",
625:         { suggestedName },
626:         65_000,
627:       );
628:       if (!target.path) return { saved: false };
629:       await writeFile(target.path, content ? `${content}\n` : "", { encoding: "utf8", mode: 0o600, flag: "w" });
630:       return { saved: true, fileName: target.fileName ?? path.basename(target.path) };
631:     } catch (error) {
632:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_EXPORT_FAILED", "Could not export the managed process log", {
633:         cause: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
634:       });
635:     }
636:   }

638:   activeForSession(sessionId: string): ManagedProcessPublicInfo[] {
639:     return [...this.records.values()]
640:       .filter((record) => record.ownerSessionId === sessionId && isManagedProcessActiveState(record.state))
641:       .map((record) => this.publicInfo(record));

804:   private async startPosixRun(
805:     record: ManagedRecord,
806:     context: ToolExecutionContext,
807:     shell: CommandDescriptor,
808:     signal?: AbortSignal,
809:   ): Promise<void> {
810:     const backend = this.posixBackendFactory();
811:     record.backend = backend;
812:     record.removeBackendListener = backend.onEvent((event) => this.handleBackendEvent(record, backend, event));
813:     let prepared: Awaited<ReturnType<ManagedProcessBackend["prepare"]>>;
814:     try {
815:       prepared = await backend.prepare(
816:         {
817:           processId: record.processId,
818:           runId: record.runId,
819:           cwd: record.cwd,
820:           command: record.command,
821:           shell: {
822:             executable: shell.executable,
823:             argvPrefix: [...shell.argvPrefix],
824:             cwdSemantics: shell.cwdSemantics,
825:           },
826:           context,
827:         },
828:         signal,
829:       );
830:     } catch (error) {
831:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
832:         "PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE",
833:         "POSIX managed process worker could not prepare containment",
834:         { subcode: boundedSystemMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "WORKER_START_FAILED") },
835:       );
836:     }
837:     record.reaper = prepared.reaper;
838:     let journalRevision: number;
839:     try {
840:       const registered = await this.parentCall<{ journalRevision?: number }>(
841:         "managedProcesses.register",
842:         { record: prepared.reaper },
843:         5_000,
844:       );
845:       if (!Number.isSafeInteger(registered.journalRevision) || (registered.journalRevision ?? 0) <= 0) {
846:         throw new Error("Invalid journal revision");
847:       }
848:       journalRevision = registered.journalRevision!;
849:       record.reaperRegistered = true;
850:     } catch {
851:       await backend.dispose();
852:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
853:         "PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE",
854:         "Could not register POSIX managed process crash recovery",
855:       );
856:     }
857:     try {
858:       await backend.commit(prepared, journalRevision);
859:     } catch (error) {
860:       await backend.dispose();
861:       throw new ManagedProcessError(
862:         "PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE",
863:         "POSIX managed process worker could not commit containment",
864:         { subcode: boundedSystemMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "WORKER_COMMIT_FAILED") },
865:       );
866:     }
867:     if (terminalState(record.state)) {
868:       await record.finish?.promise;
869:       return;
870:     }
871:     this.assertStartNotCancelled(signal);
872:     if (record.userStopBarrier) {
873:       await this.stop(record.processId, record.runId, "graceful", "user");
874:       throw new ManagedProcessError("PROCESS_USER_STOPPED", "The user stopped this process while it was starting");
875:     }
876:     if ((record.state as ManagedProcessState) !== "ready") record.state = "running";
877:     record.startedAt = this.now();
878:     this.emitChanged(record, "state");
879:   }

1015:   private handleBackendEvent(
1016:     record: ManagedRecord,
1017:     backend: ManagedProcessBackend,
1018:     event: ManagedProcessBackendEvent,
1019:   ): void {
1020:     if (record.backend !== backend) return;
1021:     if (event.type === "stdout" || event.type === "stderr") {
1022:       record.decoder.write(event.type, event.bytes);
1023:       return;
1024:     }
1025:     if (event.type === "output-dropped") {
1026:       this.append(record, "system", `[system] Backend dropped ${event.bytes} bytes / ${event.chunks} chunks.`);
1027:       return;
1028:     }
1029:     if (event.type === "stdin-closed") {
1030:       record.stdinOpen = false;
1031:       this.emitChanged(record, "state");
1032:       return;
1033:     }
1034:     if (event.type === "stopping") {
1035:       this.append(record, "system", `Stopping phase: ${event.phase}`);
1036:       return;
1037:     }
1038:     if (event.type === "error") {
1039:       const diagnostic = event.message
1040:         ? `${boundedSystemMessage(event.subcode)}: ${boundedSystemMessage(event.message)}`
1041:         : boundedSystemMessage(event.subcode);
1042:       this.append(record, "system", diagnostic);
1043:       return;
1044:     }
1045:     if (event.type === "exit") void this.finalizeBackendExit(record, backend, event.exit);
1046:   }

1048:   private async finalizeBackendExit(
1049:     record: ManagedRecord,
1050:     backend: ManagedProcessBackend,
1051:     exit: Omit<ManagedProcessExit, "finishedAt">,
1052:   ): Promise<void> {
1053:     if (record.backend !== backend || terminalState(record.state)) return;
1054:     record.decoder.end("stdout");
1055:     record.decoder.end("stderr");
1056:     const stopped = exit.reason === "stopped" || record.stopSource !== undefined || record.state === "stopping";
1057:     record.state = stopped ? "killed" : exit.reason === "host-failure" ? "lost" : exit.code === 0 ? "exited" : "failed";
1058:     record.stoppedAt = this.now();
1059:     record.stdinOpen = false;
1060:     record.exit = {
1061:       ...exit,
1062:       reason: stopped ? "stopped" : exit.reason,
1063:       ...(record.stopSource ? { stoppedBy: record.stopSource } : {}),
1064:       finishedAt: this.now(),
1065:     };
1066:     this.emitChanged(record, "exit");
1067:     this.resolveWaiters(record);
1068:     if (exit.reason === "host-failure") {
1069:       this.containmentFailed = true;
1070:       this.append(record, "system", "Managed process ownership was lost; new starts are disabled");
1071:     } else {
1072:       await this.unregisterReaper(record);
1073:     }
1074:     record.finish?.resolve();
1075:   }

1090:   private mergeEndpoints(record: ManagedRecord, endpoints: ManagedLoopbackEndpoint[]): void {

1102:       changed &&

1104:       record.readiness !== "ready" &&

1108:       record.readinessMatched = record.endpoints[0]?.url;

1124:   private async observeInitialWindow(record: ManagedRecord): Promise<void> {
1125:     if (record.readinessSpec.type === "none") {
1126:       if (record.output.allRecords().some((item) => item.stream === "stdout" || item.stream === "stderr")) return;
1127:       await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
1128:         const waiter: Waiter = { resolve };
1129:         record.waiters.add(waiter);
1130:         const timer = setTimeout(() => {
1131:           record.waiters.delete(waiter);
1132:           resolve();
1133:         }, MANAGED_PROCESS_LIMITS.startWaitDefaultMs);
1134:         timer.unref();
1135:         waiter.resolve = () => {
1136:           if (
1137:             !terminalState(record.state) &&
1138:             !record.output.allRecords().some((item) => item.stream === "stdout" || item.stream === "stderr")
1139:           ) {
1140:             return;
1141:           }
1142:           clearTimeout(timer);
1143:           record.waiters.delete(waiter);

1150:     if (record.readiness === "ready" || terminalState(record.state)) return;
1151:     await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
1152:       const waiter: Waiter = { resolve };
1153:       record.waiters.add(waiter);
1154:       const timer = setTimeout(() => {
1155:         record.waiters.delete(waiter);
1156:         resolve();
1157:       }, timeoutMs);
1158:       timer.unref();
1159:       waiter.resolve = () => {
1160:         if (record.readiness !== "ready" && !terminalState(record.state)) return;
1161:         clearTimeout(timer);

1163:         resolve();

503:     return typeof name === "string" && name.trim().length > 0;

507:     if (!filePath) return false;
508:     const storedName = SessionManager.open(filePath, undefined).getSessionName();

515: function applyLiveSessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId: string, name: string): boolean | null {
516:   const existing = getRpcSession(sessionId);
517:   if (!existing?.isAlive()) return null;
518:   const currentName = existing.inner.sessionName;
519:   if (typeof currentName === "string" && currentName.trim().length > 0) return false;
520: 
521:   // Keep the check and write in the same synchronous turn. A manual rename
522:   // that ran first is observed above; one that runs later overwrites this
523:   // automatic value, so the manual choice always wins.
524:   existing.inner.setSessionName(name);
525:   return true;
526: }

528: export async function applySessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId: string, name: string): Promise<boolean> {
529:   const normalized = name.trim();
530:   if (!normalized) return false;
531: 
532:   const liveResult = applyLiveSessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId, normalized);
533:   if (liveResult !== null) return liveResult;
534: 
535:   const filePath = await resolveSessionPath(sessionId);
536:   if (!filePath) return false;
537: 
538:   // The session may have become live while its path was resolving.
539:   const liveResultAfterLookup = applyLiveSessionNameIfEmpty(sessionId, normalized);
540:   if (liveResultAfterLookup !== null) return liveResultAfterLookup;
541: 
542:   const manager = SessionManager.open(filePath, undefined);
543:   const storedName = manager.getSessionName();
544:   if (typeof storedName === "string" && storedName.trim().length > 0) return false;
545: 
546:   // SessionManager's read and append are synchronous, so another Renderer RPC
547:   // cannot interleave a manual rename between this final check and the write.
548:   manager.appendSessionInfo(normalized);
549:   invalidateSessionContent(filePath);
550:   return true;
551: }

553: async function resolveTitleSessionTarget(
554:   sessionId: string,
555: ): Promise<{ cwd: string; services?: TitleModelServices } | null> {
556:   const existing = getRpcSession(sessionId);
557:   if (existing?.isAlive()) {
558:     const dir = validateExistingDirectory(existing.cwd);
559:     if (!dir.ok) return null;
560:     return {
561:       cwd: dir.path,
562:       services: {
563:         modelRuntime: existing.inner.modelRuntime as unknown as TitleSessionServices["modelRuntime"],
564:         settingsManager: existing.inner.settingsManager,
565:       },
566:     };
567:   }
568: 
569:   const filePath = await resolveSessionPath(sessionId);
570:   if (!filePath) return null;
571:   const cwd = SessionManager.open(filePath, undefined).getHeader()?.cwd;
572:   const dir = validateExistingDirectory(cwd);
573:   return dir.ok ? { cwd: dir.path } : null;
574: }

576: type DirectoryValidation = { ok: true; path: string; canonicalPath: string } | { ok: false; error: string };
577: 
578: function validateExistingDirectory(candidate: unknown): DirectoryValidation {
579:   if (typeof candidate !== "string" || !candidate) return { ok: false, error: "Directory does not exist" };
580:   try {
581:     const realpath = realpathSync.native ?? realpathSync;
582:     const canonicalPath = realpath(candidate);
583:     if (!statSync(canonicalPath).isDirectory()) return { ok: false, error: "Not a directory" };
584:     return { ok: true, path: candidate, canonicalPath };
585:   } catch {
586:     return { ok: false, error: "Directory does not exist" };
587:   }
588: }
589: 
590: function canonicalPathForComparison(candidate: string): string {
591:   const resolved = path.resolve(candidate);
592:   let canonical = resolved;
593:   try {
594:     const realpath = realpathSync.native ?? realpathSync;
595:     canonical = realpath(resolved);
596:   } catch {
597:     // Historical session cwd values can refer to directories that no longer exist.
598:   }
599:   return process.platform === "win32" ? canonical.toLowerCase() : canonical;
600: }

604: async function resolveAvailableModels(
605:   modelRuntime: ModelRuntime,
606:   signal?: AbortSignal,
607: ): Promise<{ models: AvailableModel[]; warnings: ModelCatalogWarning[] }> {
608:   const snapshot = [...modelRuntime.getAvailableSnapshot()];
609:   const snapshotByProvider = new Map<string, AvailableModel[]>();
610:   for (const model of snapshot) {
611:     const models = snapshotByProvider.get(model.provider) ?? [];
612:     models.push(model);
613:     snapshotByProvider.set(model.provider, models);
614:   }
615: 
616:   const results = await Promise.all(
617:     [...modelRuntime.getProviders()]
618:       .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
619:       .map(async (provider) => {
620:         try {
621:           const models = [...(await modelRuntime.getAvailable(provider.id, { signal }))];
622:           return { models, warning: undefined };
623:         } catch (error) {
624:           if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason ?? error;
625:           return {
626:             models: snapshotByProvider.get(provider.id) ?? [],
627:             warning: {
628:               provider: provider.id,
629:               code: "PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY_FAILED" as const,
630:               message: `Unable to check ${provider.id} model availability; the last known state remains available.`,
631:             },
632:           };
633:         }
634:       }),
635:   );
636:   signal?.throwIfAborted();
637:   return {
638:     models: results.flatMap((result) => result.models),
639:     warnings: results.flatMap((result) => (result.warning ? [result.warning] : [])),
640:   };
641: }

643: export async function projectModelsList(
644:   modelRuntime: ModelRuntime,
645:   settings: SettingsManager,
646:   catalog: ModelCatalogStatus,
647:   options: { signal?: AbortSignal; cachedOnly?: boolean } = {},
648: ): Promise<ModelsListResult> {
649:   const availability = options.cachedOnly
650:     ? { models: [...modelRuntime.getAvailableSnapshot()], warnings: [] }
651:     : await resolveAvailableModels(modelRuntime, options.signal);
652:   const available = availability.models;
653:   const enabledModels = settings.getEnabledModels();
654:   const visible = filterByExactEnabledModels(available, enabledModels);
655:   const models = visible
656:     .map((model) => ({ id: model.id, name: model.name, provider: model.provider }))
657:     .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) || a.provider.localeCompare(b.provider));
658: 
659:   const nameMap: Record<string, string> = {};
660:   const thinkingLevels: Record<string, string[]> = {};
661:   const thinkingLevelMaps: Record<string, Record<string, string | null>> = {};
662:   for (const model of visible) {
663:     const key = `${model.provider}:${model.id}`;
664:     nameMap[key] = model.name;
665:     thinkingLevels[key] = getSupportedThinkingLevels(model);
666:     if (model.thinkingLevelMap) thinkingLevelMaps[key] = model.thinkingLevelMap;
667:   }
668: 
669:   let defaultModel: { provider: string; modelId: string } | null = null;
670:   const provider = settings.getDefaultProvider();
671:   const modelId = settings.getDefaultModel();
672:   if (provider && modelId && visible.some((model) => model.provider === provider && model.id === modelId)) {
673:     defaultModel = { provider, modelId };
674:   }
675: 
676:   return {
677:     models,
678:     defaultModel,
679:     thinkingLevels,
680:     thinkingLevelMaps,
681:     nameMap,
682:     catalog: availability.warnings.length
683:       ? { ...catalog, warnings: [...catalog.warnings, ...availability.warnings] }
684:       : catalog,
685:   };
686: }

2:  * Watch ~/.pi/agent session directory and push sessions.changed events.

4: import fs from "fs";

10: import { classifySessionWatchChange } from "./session-watch-policy";
11: 
12: export function startSessionWatcher(server: RpcServer): () => void {
13:   let agentDir: string;
14:   try {
15:     agentDir = getAgentDir();
16:   } catch {
17:     return () => {};
18:   }
19: 
20:   if (!fs.existsSync(agentDir)) {
21:     try {
22:       fs.mkdirSync(agentDir, { recursive: true });
23:     } catch {
24:       return () => {};
25:     }
26:   }
27: 
28:   const sessionsRoot = path.resolve(process.env.PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR || path.join(agentDir, "sessions"));
29:   const changedPaths = new Set<string>();
30:   let fullRefreshRequired = false;
31:   let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
32:   const debounce = (changedPath?: string) => {
33:     if (changedPath) changedPaths.add(changedPath);
34:     else fullRefreshRequired = true;
35:     if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
36:     timer = setTimeout(() => {
37:       void (async () => {
38:         timer = null;
39:         try {
40:           invalidateAllowedRootsCache();
41:           const pendingPaths = [...changedPaths];
42:           changedPaths.clear();
43:           const shouldRefreshAll = fullRefreshRequired;
44:           fullRefreshRequired = false;
45:           if (shouldRefreshAll) {
46:             await sessionIndex.refreshAll();
47:             server.emit("sessions.changed", "*", { cwd: null, fullRefresh: true });
48:             return;
49:           }
50:           for (const filePath of pendingPaths) {
51:             const previous = sessionIndex.getByPath(filePath);
52:             const session = await sessionIndex.refreshPath(filePath);
53:             if (session) {
54:               server.emit("sessions.changed", session.id, { cwd: session.cwd, sessionId: session.id, session });
55:             } else if (previous) {
56:               server.emit("sessions.changed", previous.id, {
57:                 cwd: previous.cwd,
58:                 sessionId: previous.id,
59:                 deleted: true,
60:               });
61:             } else {
62:               server.emit("sessions.changed", "*", { cwd: null, fullRefresh: true });
63:             }
64:           }
65:         } catch (error) {
66:           console.error("[agent-host] session watcher refresh failed:", error);
67:           server.emit("sessions.changed", "*", { cwd: null, fullRefresh: true });
68:         }
69:       })();
70:     }, 300);
71:   };
72: 
73:   let watcher: fs.FSWatcher | null = null;
74:   try {
75:     watcher = fs.watch(agentDir, { recursive: true }, (_event, filename) => {
76:       const change = classifySessionWatchChange(agentDir, sessionsRoot, filename);
77:       if (change.kind === "refresh-path") debounce(change.path);
78:       else if (change.kind === "refresh-all") debounce();
79:     });
80:     watcher.on("error", (err) => {
81:       console.error("[agent-host] session watcher error:", err);
82:       setAllowedRootsWatcherHealthy(false);
83:       invalidateAllowedRootsCache();
84:     });
85:     setAllowedRootsWatcherHealthy(true);
86:   } catch (err) {
87:     console.error("[agent-host] session watcher failed:", err);
88:   }
89: 
90:   return () => {
91:     if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
92:     watcher?.close();
93:     setAllowedRootsWatcherHealthy(false);
94:   };
95: }

98:   return path.join(getAgentDir());

575:   async send(command: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
576:     this.resetIdleTimer();
577:     const type = command.type as string;
578:     if (this.shouldWaitForExtensions(type)) await this.waitForExtensionsBound();
579: 
580:     switch (type) {
581:       case "prompt": {
582:         // Fire and forget — events come via subscribe
583:         const promptImages = command.images as Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }> | undefined;
584:         const streamingBehavior = command.streamingBehavior as "steer" | "followUp" | undefined;
585:         if (!streamingBehavior) browserAgentRuntime.beginTurn(this.sessionId, "local");
586:         const invokePrompt = () =>
587:           this.inner.prompt(command.message as string, {
588:             ...(promptImages?.length ? { images: promptImages } : {}),
589:             ...(streamingBehavior ? { streamingBehavior } : {}),
590:             source: "rpc",
591:           });
592:         const operation = streamingBehavior ? invokePrompt() : this.enqueueTurn(invokePrompt);
593:         operation
594:           .then(() => {
595:             if (!streamingBehavior) this.emit({ type: "prompt_done" });
596:           })
597:           .catch((error) => {
598:             this.emit({
599:               type: "prompt_error",
600:               errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
601:             });
602:             if (!streamingBehavior) this.emit({ type: "prompt_done" });
603:           });
604:         return null;
605:       }
606: 
607:       case "abort":
608:         await this.withFinalRunningNotification(() => this.inner.abort());
609:         return null;
610: 
611:       case "get_state": {
612:         const model = this.inner.model;
613:         const contextUsage = this.inner.getContextUsage();
614:         return {
615:           sessionId: this.inner.sessionId,
616:           sessionFile: this.inner.sessionFile ?? "",
617:           isStreaming: this.inner.isStreaming,
618:           isPromptRunning: this.promptRunning,
619:           isCompacting: this.inner.isCompacting,
620:           autoCompactionEnabled: this.inner.autoCompactionEnabled,
621:           autoRetryEnabled: this.inner.autoRetryEnabled,
622:           model: model ? { id: model.id, provider: model.provider } : undefined,
623:           messageCount: 0,
624:           pendingMessageCount: this.inner.pendingMessageCount,
625:           queuedMessages: {
626:             steering: [...this.inner.getSteeringMessages()],
627:             followUp: [...this.inner.getFollowUpMessages()],
628:           },
629:           contextUsage: contextUsage
630:             ? { percent: contextUsage.percent, contextWindow: contextUsage.contextWindow, tokens: contextUsage.tokens }
631:             : null,
632:           systemPrompt: this.inner.agent.state?.systemPrompt ?? "",
633:           thinkingLevel: this.inner.agent.state?.thinkingLevel ?? "off",
634:           extensionStatuses: this.getExtensionStatuses(),
635:           extensionWidgets: this.getExtensionWidgets(),
636:         };
637:       }
638: 
639:       case "set_model": {
640:         const { provider, modelId } = command as { provider: string; modelId: string };
641:         const model = this.inner.modelRuntime.getModel(provider, modelId);
642:         if (!model) throw new Error(`Model not found: ${provider}/${modelId}`);
643:         await this.inner.setModel(model);
644:         return { id: model.id, provider: model.provider };
645:       }
646: 
647:       case "fork": {
648:         const entryId = command.entryId as string;
649:         const sessionManager = this.inner.sessionManager;
650:         const currentSessionFile = this.inner.sessionFile;
651: 
652:         if (!sessionManager.isPersisted()) return { cancelled: true };
653:         if (!currentSessionFile) throw new Error("Persisted session is missing a session file");
654: 
655:         const entry = sessionManager.getEntry(entryId);
656:         if (!entry) throw new Error("Invalid entry ID for forking");
657: 
658:         const sessionDir = sessionManager.getSessionDir();
659:         let newSessionFile: string;
660: 
661:         if (!entry.parentId) {
662:           // Fork before the first message: create an empty session linked to this one
663:           const newManager = SessionManager.create(sessionManager.getCwd(), sessionDir);
664:           newManager.newSession({ parentSession: currentSessionFile });
665:           newSessionFile = newManager.getSessionFile() as string;
666:         } else {
667:           // Fork after some history: copy path up to (but not including) the fork point
668:           const sourceManager = SessionManager.open(currentSessionFile, sessionDir);
669:           const forkedPath = sourceManager.createBranchedSession(entry.parentId);
670:           if (!forkedPath) throw new Error("Failed to create forked session");
671:           newSessionFile = forkedPath;
672:         }
673: 
674:         const newSessionId = SessionManager.open(newSessionFile, sessionDir).getSessionId();
675:         cacheSessionPath(newSessionId, newSessionFile);
676:         await this.dispose({ abort: true, reason: "fork" });
677:         return { cancelled: false, newSessionId };
678:       }
679: 
680:       case "navigate_tree": {
681:         const result = await this.inner.navigateTree(command.targetId as string, {});
682:         return { cancelled: result.cancelled };
683:       }
684: 
685:       case "set_thinking_level": {
686:         const level = command.level as string;
687:         this.inner.setThinkingLevel(level);
688:         // setThinkingLevel clamps xhigh→high for models where supportsXhigh()===false.
689:         // If the model has DeepSeek thinking compat (reasoningEffortMap maps xhigh→max),
690:         // force the state back so the compat layer can use it correctly.
691:         if (
692:           level === "xhigh" &&
693:           (this.inner.model as { compat?: { thinkingFormat?: string } } | null)?.compat?.thinkingFormat ===
694:             "deepseek" &&
695:           this.inner.agent?.state
696:         ) {
697:           this.inner.agent.state.thinkingLevel = "xhigh";
698:         }
699:         return null;
700:       }
701: 
702:       case "compact": {
703:         const result = await this.withFinalRunningNotification(() =>
704:           this.enqueueTurn(() => this.inner.compact(command.customInstructions as string | undefined)),
705:         );
706:         return result;
707:       }
708: 
709:       case "set_session_name": {
710:         const name = (command.name as string | undefined)?.trim();
711:         if (!name) throw new Error("Session name cannot be empty");
712:         this.inner.setSessionName(name);
713:         return null;
714:       }
715: 
716:       case "get_session_stats": {
717:         return {
718:           ...this.inner.getSessionStats(),
719:           sessionName: this.inner.sessionManager.getSessionName(),
720:         };
721:       }
722: 
723:       case "get_last_assistant_text": {
724:         return { text: this.inner.getLastAssistantText() ?? "" };
725:       }
726: 
727:       case "set_auto_compaction": {
728:         this.inner.setAutoCompactionEnabled(command.enabled as boolean);
729:         return null;
730:       }
731: 
732:       case "clear_queue": {
733:         // Full clear only: pi has no single-item dequeue, and clear+requeue
734:         // races against the agent loop pulling messages mid-flight.
735:         return this.inner.clearQueue();
736:       }
737: 
738:       case "steer": {
739:         const steerImages = command.images as Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }> | undefined;
740:         await this.inner.steer(command.message as string, steerImages?.length ? steerImages : undefined);
741:         return null;
742:       }
743: 
744:       case "follow_up": {
745:         const followImages = command.images as Array<{ type: "image"; data: string; mimeType: string }> | undefined;
746:         await this.inner.followUp(command.message as string, followImages?.length ? followImages : undefined);
747:         return null;
748:       }
749: 
750:       case "get_tools": {
751:         const all: ToolInfo[] = this.inner.getAllTools();
752:         const active = new Set<string>(this.inner.getActiveToolNames());
753:         return all.map((t) => ({
754:           name: t.name,
755:           description: t.description,
756:           active: active.has(t.name),
757:         }));
758:       }
759: 
760:       case "get_commands": {
761:         const commands: SlashCommandInfo[] = [];
762:         for (const registered of this.inner.extensionRunner.getRegisteredCommands()) {
763:           commands.push({
764:             name: registered.invocationName,
765:             description: registered.description,
766:             source: "extension",
767:             sourceInfo: registered.sourceInfo,
768:           });
769:         }
770:         for (const template of this.inner.promptTemplates) {
771:           commands.push({
772:             name: template.name,
773:             description: template.description,
774:             source: "prompt",
775:             sourceInfo: template.sourceInfo,
776:           });
777:         }
778:         for (const skill of this.inner.resourceLoader.getSkills().skills) {
779:           commands.push({
780:             name: `skill:${skill.name}`,
781:             description: skill.description,
782:             source: "skill",
783:             sourceInfo: skill.sourceInfo,
784:           });
785:         }
786:         return { commands };
787:       }
788: 
789:       case "set_tools": {
790:         const toolNames = command.toolNames as string[];
791:         this.applyRequestedTools(toolNames);
792:         this.persistToolNames(this.sessionId, toolNames);
793:         return null;
794:       }
795: 
796:       case "reload": {
797:         await this.enqueueTurn(() => this.reloadSessionResources());
798:         this.syncBrowserToolActivation();
799:         return { success: true };
800:       }
801: 
802:       case "abort_compaction": {
803:         this.inner.abortCompaction();
804:         return null;
805:       }
806: 
807:       case "extension_ui_response": {
808:         this.resolveExtensionUiResponse(command as ExtensionUiResponse);
809:         return null;
810:       }
811: 
812:       case "extension_ui_input": {
813:         this.handleExtensionUiInput(command.id as string, command.data as string);
814:         return null;
815:       }
816: 
817:       case "set_auto_retry": {
818:         this.inner.setAutoRetryEnabled(command.enabled as boolean);
819:         return null;
820:       }
821: 
822:       default:
823:         throw new Error(`Unsupported command: ${type}`);
824:     }
825:   }

827:   /**
828:    * Stop the underlying agent and release resources. Calls are idempotent and
829:    * concurrent owners share one teardown attempt.
830:    */
831:   dispose(options: { abort?: boolean; reason?: string; timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<void> {
832:     if (this.disposePromise) return this.disposePromise;
833:     const abort = options.abort !== false;
834:     const reason = options.reason ?? "explicit";
835:     const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 5_000;
836:     this.destroy();
837: 
838:     this.disposePromise = (async () => {
839:       const teardown = async () => {
840:         if (abort) {
841:           try {
842:             await this.inner.abort();
843:           } catch (error) {
844:             console.warn(
845:               `[pi-desktop] session abort failed during ${reason} for ${this.sessionId}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError"}`,
846:             );
847:           }
848:         }
849:         const agent = this.inner.agent as { waitForIdle?: () => Promise<void>; dispose?: () => void | Promise<void> };
850:         try {
851:           await agent.waitForIdle?.();
852:         } catch (error) {
853:           console.warn(
854:             `[pi-desktop] session waitForIdle failed during ${reason} for ${this.sessionId}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError"}`,
855:           );
856:         }
857:         try {
858:           await agent.dispose?.();
859:         } catch (error) {
860:           console.warn(
861:             `[pi-desktop] session dispose failed during ${reason} for ${this.sessionId}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError"}`,
862:           );
863:         }
864:       };
865: 
866:       let timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
867:       try {
868:         await Promise.race([
869:           teardown(),
870:           new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
871:             timeout = setTimeout(() => {
872:               console.warn(`[pi-desktop] session teardown timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms during ${reason}`);
873:               resolve();
874:             }, timeoutMs);
875:           }),
876:         ]);
877:       } finally {
878:         if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
879:       }
880:     })();
881:     return this.disposePromise;
882:   }
883: 
884:   async abortAndDispose(): Promise<void> {
885:     await this.dispose({ abort: true, reason: "explicit" });
886:   }

888:   destroy(): void {
889:     if (!this._alive) return;
890:     this._alive = false;
891:     browserAgentRuntime.clearSession(this.sessionId);
892:     if (this.idleTimer) clearTimeout(this.idleTimer);
893:     this.unsubscribe?.();
894:     this.unsubscribe = null;
895:     for (const pending of this.pendingUiResponses.values()) pending.cancel();
896:     for (const id of Array.from(this.activeCustomUis.keys())) this.closeCustomUi(id, undefined);
897:     this.pendingUiResponses.clear();
898:     this.pendingUiRequests.clear();
899:     this.listeners = [];
900:     const destroyCallbacks = [...this.destroyCallbacks];
901:     this.destroyCallbacks.clear();
902:     for (const callback of destroyCallbacks) {
903:       try {
904:         callback();
905:       } catch {
906:         /* isolate teardown owners */
907:       }
908:     }
909:     notifyRunningChange();
910:   }

962:   private getCustomUiWidth(options: unknown): number {

1026:   private requestExtensionCustomUi<T>(factory: unknown, options?: unknown): Promise<T> {
1027:     if (this.externalTurnActive) {
1028:       this.emit({
1029:         type: "channel_headless_ui_blocked",
1030:         feature: "custom",
1031:         errorMessage: "Interactive extension UI is unavailable for messaging-channel turns.",
1032:       });
1033:       return Promise.resolve(undefined as T);
1034:     }
1035:     if (typeof factory !== "function") return Promise.resolve(undefined as T);
1036: 
1037:     const id = randomUUID();
1038:     const width = this.getCustomUiWidth(options);
1039: 
1040:     return new Promise<T>((resolve) => {
1041:       const tui = {
1042:         requestRender: () => {
1043:           const custom = this.activeCustomUis.get(id);
1044:           if (custom) this.emitCustomUiRender(id, custom);
1045:         },
1046:       };
1047:       const done = (value: T) => this.closeCustomUi(id, value);
1048: 
1049:       Promise.resolve()
1050:         .then(() => factory(tui, undefined, undefined, done))
1051:         .then((component) => {
1052:           if (
1053:             !component ||
1054:             typeof component !== "object" ||
1055:             typeof (component as CustomUiComponent).render !== "function"
1056:           ) {
1057:             resolve(undefined as T);
1058:             return;
1059:           }
1060:           const custom: ActiveCustomUi = {
1061:             component: component as CustomUiComponent,
1062:             width,
1063:             resolve: (value) => resolve(value as T),
1064:             settled: false,
1065:           };
1066:           this.activeCustomUis.set(id, custom);
1067:           this.emitCustomUiRender(id, custom);
1068:         })
1069:         .catch((error) => {
1070:           this.emit({
1071:             type: "extension_error",
1072:             extensionPath: `custom-ui:${id}`,
1073:             event: "custom_ui",
1074:             error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
1075:           });
1076:           resolve(undefined as T);
1077:         });
1078:     });
1079:   }

1081:   private requestExtensionUi<T>(
1082:     request: ExtensionUiRequestBody,
1083:     defaultValue: T,
1084:     parseResponse: (response: ExtensionUiResponse) => T,
1085:     timeout?: number,
1086:     signal?: AbortSignal,
1087:   ): Promise<T> {
1088:     if (this.externalTurnActive) {
1089:       this.emit({
1090:         type: "channel_headless_ui_blocked",
1091:         feature: request.method,
1092:         errorMessage: "Interactive extension UI is unavailable for messaging-channel turns.",
1093:       });
1094:       return Promise.resolve(defaultValue);
1095:     }
1096:     if (signal?.aborted) return Promise.resolve(defaultValue);
1097: 
1098:     const id = randomUUID();
1099:     const fullRequest = {
1100:       type: "extension_ui_request",
1101:       id,
1102:       ...request,
1103:       ...(timeout ? { timeout, expiresAt: Date.now() + timeout } : {}),
1104:     };
1105: 
1106:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
1107:       let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
1108:       const cleanup = () => {
1109:         if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
1110:         signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);

61:   return /(?:app[ _-]?(?:id|secret)|credential|client assertion|token).{0,40}(?:invalid|incorrect|expired|missing|empty|mismatch)|(?:invalid|incorrect|expired|missing|empty|mismatch).{0,40}(?:app[ _-]?(?:id|secret)|credential|client assertion|token)|permission|forbidden|unauthori[sz]ed|access denied|scope|权限|授权|凭证|密钥|鉴权|认证/i.test(
62:     error.message,
63:   );
64: }

66: export function feishuReconnectDelay(retryCount: number, random = Math.random): number {
67:   const exponent = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.floor(retryCount) - 1));
68:   const base = Math.min(1_000 * 2 ** exponent, 25_000);
69:   const jitterWindow = Math.min(5_000, Math.ceil(base * 0.2));
70:   const jitter = Math.floor(Math.max(0, Math.min(0.999_999, random())) * (jitterWindow + 1));
71:   return Math.min(FEISHU_RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY_MS, base + jitter);
72: }

74: function waitForReconnect(ms: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
75:   if (signal.aborted) return Promise.resolve();
76:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
77:     let settled = false;
78:     const finish = () => {
79:       if (settled) return;
80:       settled = true;
81:       clearTimeout(timer);
82:       signal.removeEventListener("abort", finish);
83:       resolve();
84:     };
85:     const timer = setTimeout(finish, ms);
86:     signal.addEventListener("abort", finish, { once: true });
87:   });
88: }

97: function parseContent(content: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
98:   try {
99:     const parsed = JSON.parse(content) as unknown;
100:     return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : null;
101:   } catch {
102:     return null;
103:   }

111:   return mentionOpenId(mention) === botOpenId;

114: function normalizeMessageText(text: string): string {
115:   return text
116:     .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, "\n")
117:     .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
118:     .trim();
119: }

121: function stripBotMentionKeys(text: string, mentions: FeishuMessageMention[] | undefined, botOpenId: string): string {
122:   let result = text;
123:   for (const mention of mentions ?? []) {
124:     if (isBotMention(mention, botOpenId) && mention.key) result = result.split(mention.key).join("");
125:   }
126:   return normalizeMessageText(result);
127: }

129: function postNodeText(value: unknown, botOpenId: string): string {
130:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return "";
131:   const node = value as Record<string, unknown>;
132:   if (node.tag === "text" || node.tag === "a") return typeof node.text === "string" ? node.text : "";
133:   if (node.tag === "at") {
134:     if (node.user_id === botOpenId) return "";
135:     const name = typeof node.user_name === "string" ? node.user_name : "";
136:     return name ? `@${name}` : "";
137:   }
138:   return "";
139: }

141: function extractPostText(content: Record<string, unknown>, botOpenId: string): string {
142:   const direct = Array.isArray(content.content) ? content : undefined;
143:   const localized = direct
144:     ? direct
145:     : Object.values(content).find((value): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
146:         Boolean(
147:           value &&
148:           typeof value === "object" &&
149:           !Array.isArray(value) &&
150:           Array.isArray((value as Record<string, unknown>).content),
151:         ),
152:       );
153:   if (!localized) return "";
154:   const title = typeof localized.title === "string" ? localized.title : "";
155:   const rows = (localized.content as unknown[])
156:     .filter(Array.isArray)
157:     .map((row) => (row as unknown[]).map((node) => postNodeText(node, botOpenId)).join(""));
158:   return normalizeMessageText([title, ...rows].filter(Boolean).join("\n"));
159: }

161: function contentAndAttachments(
162:   event: FeishuMessageEvent,
163:   botOpenId: string,
164: ): { text: string; attachments: InboundAttachment[] } {
165:   const type = event.message.message_type;
166:   const content = parseContent(event.message.content);
167:   if (type === "text") {
168:     return { text: typeof content?.text === "string" ? content.text : "", attachments: [] };
169:   }
170:   if (type === "post") return { text: content ? extractPostText(content, botOpenId) : "", attachments: [] };
171:   if (type === "image") return { text: "", attachments: [{ kind: "image" }] };
172:   if (type === "file") {
173:     return {
174:       text: "",
175:       attachments: [
176:         {
177:           kind: "file",
178:           ...(typeof content?.file_name === "string" ? { name: content.file_name } : {}),
179:         },
180:       ],
181:     };
182:   }
183:   if (type === "audio") return { text: "", attachments: [{ kind: "voice" }] };
184:   if (type === "media" || type === "video") return { text: "", attachments: [{ kind: "video" }] };
185:   return { text: "", attachments: [] };
186: }

192: function downloadableResources(event: FeishuMessageEvent): FeishuResourceRequest[] {
193:   const content = parseContent(event.message.content);
194:   if (!content) return [];
195:   const fileKey = typeof content.file_key === "string" ? content.file_key.trim() : "";
196:   const imageKey = typeof content.image_key === "string" ? content.image_key.trim() : "";
197:   const fileName = typeof content.file_name === "string" ? content.file_name : undefined;
198:   switch (event.message.message_type) {
199:     case "image":
200:       return imageKey
201:         ? [{ messageId: event.message.message_id, fileKey: imageKey, resourceType: "image", kind: "image" }]
202:         : [];
203:     case "file":
204:       return fileKey
205:         ? [
206:             {
207:               messageId: event.message.message_id,
208:               fileKey,
209:               resourceType: "file",
210:               kind: "file",
211:               ...(fileName ? { name: fileName } : {}),
212:             },
213:           ]
214:         : [];
215:     case "audio":
216:       return fileKey
217:         ? [
218:             {
219:               messageId: event.message.message_id,
220:               fileKey,
221:               resourceType: "file",
222:               kind: "voice",
223:               name: fileName || "voice.opus",
224:               mime: "audio/ogg",
225:             },
226:           ]
227:         : [];
228:     case "media":
229:     case "video":
230:       return fileKey
231:         ? [
232:             {
233:               messageId: event.message.message_id,
234:               fileKey,
235:               resourceType: "file",
236:               kind: "video",
237:               name: fileName || "video.mp4",
238:               mime: "video/mp4",
239:             },
240:           ]
241:         : [];
242:     default:
243:       return [];
244:   }

258: class FeishuTurnOutput implements AdapterTurnOutput {
259:   private readonly builder = new FeishuRichMessageBuilder();
260:   private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
261:   private tail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
262:   private session: FeishuRichCardSession | undefined;
263:   private lastDraft = "";
264:   private lastError: unknown;
265:   private disabled = false;
266:   private finished = false;
267:   private reactionTail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
268:   private reactionId: string | undefined;
269: 
270:   constructor(
271:     private readonly context: AdapterTurnContext,
272:     private readonly intervalMs: number,
273:     private readonly startCard: (context: AdapterTurnContext, card: FeishuCard) => Promise<FeishuRichCardSession>,
274:     private readonly sendFinalCard: (context: AdapterTurnContext, card: FeishuCard) => Promise<DeliveryReceipt>,
275:     private readonly sendPlain: (context: AdapterTurnContext, text: string) => Promise<DeliveryReceipt>,
276:     private readonly addReaction: (context: AdapterTurnContext, emojiType: string) => Promise<string>,
277:     private readonly removeReaction: (context: AdapterTurnContext, reactionId: string) => Promise<void>,
278:     private readonly timers: Pick<typeof globalThis, "setTimeout" | "clearTimeout">,
279:   ) {
280:     this.queueReaction("THINKING");
281:     this.schedule(0);
282:   }
283: 
284:   private queueReaction(emojiType: string): void {
285:     if (!this.context.replyToMessageId) return;
286:     this.reactionTail = this.reactionTail
287:       .then(async () => {
288:         if (this.reactionId) {
289:           const previous = this.reactionId;
290:           this.reactionId = undefined;
291:           await this.removeReaction(this.context, previous).catch(() => undefined);
292:         }
293:         this.reactionId = await this.addReaction(this.context, emojiType);
294:       })
295:       .catch(() => {
296:         this.reactionId = undefined;
297:       });
298:   }
299: 
300:   update(event: ChannelTurnProgressEvent): void {
301:     if (this.finished) return;
302:     this.builder.update(event);
303:     this.schedule(this.intervalMs);
304:   }
305: 
306:   private schedule(delayMs: number): void {
307:     if (this.finished || this.disabled || this.timer) return;
308:     this.timer = this.timers.setTimeout(() => {
309:       this.timer = null;
310:       try {
311:         this.flush();
312:       } catch (error) {
313:         this.lastError = error;
314:         this.disabled = true;
315:       }
316:     }, delayMs);
317:   }
318: 
319:   private flush(): void {
320:     const draft = this.builder.renderDraft();
321:     if (!draft || draft === this.lastDraft) return;
322:     this.lastDraft = draft;
323:     this.tail = this.tail
324:       .then(async () => {
325:         if (this.disabled) return;
326:         if (!this.session) this.session = await this.startCard(this.context, buildFeishuStreamingCard());
327:         if (!this.finished) await this.session.update(draft);
328:       })
329:       .catch((error) => {
330:         // Rich preview is optional. A partial Agent event or CardKit failure
331:         // must disable only this turn and never escape the timer chain.
332:         this.lastError = error;
333:         this.disabled = true;
334:       });
335:   }
336: 
337:   private async sendDurableFinal(text: string, card: FeishuCard): Promise<DeliveryReceipt> {
338:     try {
339:       return await this.sendFinalCard(this.context, card);
340:     } catch (error) {
341:       if (!canFallbackFromFeishuCard(error)) throw error;
342:       return this.sendPlain(this.context, text);
343:     }
344:   }
345: 
346:   async finish(text: string): Promise<DeliveryReceipt> {
347:     this.finished = true;
348:     if (this.timer) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.timer);
349:     this.timer = null;
350:     await this.tail;
351: 
352:     try {
353:       const final = this.builder.renderFinal(text);
354:       let result: DeliveryReceipt;
355:       if (this.session) {
356:         if (final.answerTruncated) {
357:           await this.session.finish(final.card).catch(() => undefined);
358:           result = await this.sendPlain(this.context, text);
359:         } else {
360:           try {
361:             await this.session.finish(final.card);
362:             result = receipt(this.context, this.session.messageId);
363:           } catch {
364:             // The streaming card already exists. Prefer a second durable final
365:             // card over losing the answer when the original card cannot finalize.
366:             result = await this.sendDurableFinal(text, final.card);
367:           }
368:         }
369:       } else {
370:         if (this.lastError && !canFallbackFromFeishuCard(this.lastError)) throw this.lastError;
371:         result = final.answerTruncated
372:           ? await this.sendPlain(this.context, text)
373:           : await this.sendDurableFinal(text, final.card);
374:       }
375:       this.queueReaction("DONE");
376:       return result;
377:     } catch (error) {
378:       this.queueReaction("ERROR");
379:       throw error;
380:     }
381:   }
382: 
383:   async cancel(): Promise<void> {
384:     this.finished = true;
385:     if (this.timer) this.timers.clearTimeout(this.timer);
386:     this.timer = null;
387:     await this.tail;
388:     await this.session?.finish(buildFeishuInterruptedCard()).catch(() => undefined);
389:     this.queueReaction("ERROR");
390:   }
391: }

393: export function normalizeFeishuEvent(
394:   event: FeishuMessageEvent,
395:   account: ChannelAccountConfig,
396:   bot: FeishuBotIdentity,
397: ): InboundEnvelope | null {
398:   if (!event.message?.message_id || !event.message.chat_id || event.sender?.sender_type !== "user") return null;
399:   const senderId = event.sender.sender_id?.open_id;
400:   if (!senderId) return null;
401:   const peerKind = event.message.chat_type === "p2p" ? "dm" : "group";
402:   const mentions = event.message.mentions;
403:   const mentionsBot = Boolean(mentions?.some((mention) => isBotMention(mention, bot.openId)));
404:   const normalized = contentAndAttachments(event, bot.openId);
405:   const text = stripBotMentionKeys(normalized.text, mentions, bot.openId);
406:   const threadId = event.message.thread_id || event.message.root_id;
407:   const parentMessageId = event.message.parent_id || event.message.root_id;
408:   const timestamp = Number(event.message.create_time);
409:   return {
410:     id: event.message.message_id,
411:     channel: "feishu",
412:     accountId: account.id,
413:     peer: { kind: peerKind, id: peerKind === "dm" ? senderId : event.message.chat_id },
414:     ...(threadId ? { threadId } : {}),
415:     sender: { id: senderId },
416:     text,
417:     mentionsBot,
418:     ...(parentMessageId ? { replyTo: { messageId: parentMessageId } } : {}),
419:     attachments: normalized.attachments,
420:     timestamp: Number.isFinite(timestamp) && timestamp > 0 ? timestamp : Date.now(),
421:     providerContext: { replyToMessageId: event.message.message_id },
422:   };
423: }
424: 
425: export function normalizeFeishuMenuEvent(
426:   event: FeishuMenuEvent,
427:   account: ChannelAccountConfig,
428: ): InboundEnvelope | null {
429:   const senderId = event.operator?.operator_id?.open_id;
430:   const eventKey = event.event_key?.trim();
431:   const text = eventKey ? FEISHU_MENU_COMMANDS[eventKey] : undefined;
432:   if (!senderId || !text) return null;
433:   const rawTimestamp = Number(event.create_time ?? event.timestamp);
434:   const timestamp =
435:     Number.isFinite(rawTimestamp) && rawTimestamp > 0
436:       ? rawTimestamp < 10_000_000_000
437:         ? rawTimestamp * 1_000
438:         : rawTimestamp
439:       : Date.now();
440:   const id = event.event_id?.trim() || `menu:${senderId}:${eventKey}:${timestamp}`;
441:   const senderName = event.operator?.operator_name?.trim();
442:   return {
443:     id,
444:     channel: "feishu",
445:     accountId: account.id,
446:     peer: { kind: "dm", id: senderId },
447:     sender: { id: senderId, ...(senderName ? { name: senderName } : {}) },
448:     text,
449:     mentionsBot: true,
450:     attachments: [],
451:     timestamp,
452:   };
453: }
